name: @rbtv/office-design
description: Dependency manifest for the design component. ONE package manager (npm) per the one-platform-per-component rule; npm resolves nothing of its own here today. Python bits (Playwright, Pillow) are HOST SYSTEM elements in rbtv.system — npm cannot express them. Playwright drives Chromium for screenshot-capture and vision-to-json reference work; Pillow does image handling for screenshot-capture. Declaration only; never published, never installed in place.
